text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, Fenomeno and Win Variation were training together on the slopes.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Fenomeno-san,
your stamina's gotten even more impressive, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Those words are a great encouragement, sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: No, no... but man, that thing earlier really caught me off guard――

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"‘Become a spear, a spear that pierces straight through the truth!’
Uoooooooh!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh... What was that all about?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is a famous line from the drama "Chronicles of the Fleet-Footed Detective."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I'm about to give up from hardcore training,
the boss always tells me!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: And thanks to that, look at me now!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Now, I've become capable of demonstrating my full power
even when reciting the lines myself, sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I-I see... That's a really understanding Trainer you've got.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! Boss is the greatest Trainer of all!!
